meta.author:
火把音樂
詞／曲：林書葦 Shu Wei Lin、洪珮貞 PJ Hung、黃喜蓉 Kiyo Huang、盧苑儀 Vivien Loh

lines.a: 創世之前 我已被揀選
lines.b: I was chosen, before time began

lines.a: 愛子的血 使我成為聖潔
lines.b: A sacred man, by the blood of the Son

lines.a: 忘記背後 來努力面前
lines.b: Leaving the past, I strive for what's ahead

lines.a: 朝著標竿 奔赴直到終點
lines.b: With all my might, I'll press on to the end

lines.a: 放下過去 傷痕累累
lines.b: All wounds will heal, all scars will cease

lines.a: 相信會有 華冠代替爐灰
lines.b: A crown of beauty instead of ashes
For you have planned it all

lines.a: 得著救贖 都全是恩典
lines.b: Now I'm redeemed, all by Your grace

lines.a: 得蒙赦免 都全是恩典
lines.b: Sins forgiven, all by Your grace

lines.a: 回想一切 怎能不感謝祢 心充滿感謝
lines.b: Reflecting back, overflowing with grace, My heart finds its place

lines.a: 得著建造 都全是恩典
lines.b: Built up by You, all by Your grace

lines.a: 得以站立 都全是恩典
lines.b: I'm standing tall, all by Your grace

lines.a: 開口稱謝 一起來稱謝祢 一起來稱謝
lines.b: Let's shout it out, give thanks and praise to You, Give thanks and praise

lines.a: 拿起火把 傳遞無限希望
lines.b: Lifting the torch, Igniting hearts with hope
